## s08-v10 — argument map

Ever (satatam) at Your lotus-feet (bhavaccaraṇāmbujākaracarasya), of me the best hamsa (hi haṃsavarasya) moving in the lake (me). Above from root below (upari mūlatalād api), and from inside (cāntarād) — may devotion's lotus-stalk (bhaktimṛṇālikā) bend up (upanamatv), unborn (aja) Lord. Hamsa-and-stalk botany: joining below, inside, above.

### Open
- Whether 'haṃsavarasya' means 'best hamsa' or 'swan-king' is unresolved.
- Whether 'bhaktimṛṇālikā' means 'devotion's lotus-stalk' or 'the stalk of devotion' is unresolved.
